slide1.headline: Nava Raises $22M
slide1.subtitle: Expanding GPU Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Enterprise AI startup Nava raised $22M led by Greenoaks Capital.
The funding will be used to expand GPU cloud and data centre infrastructure.
Nava aims to provide more efficient AI solutions for businesses.
The investment highlights the growing demand for AI infrastructure.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will help Nava to improve its AI capabilities and provide better services to its clients.
The expansion of GPU cloud and data centre infrastructure will enable Nava to handle larger AI workloads.
This investment is a significant step forward for Nava and the AI industry as a whole.
It demonstrates the confidence of investors in the potential of AI to transform businesses.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The AI market is expected to continue growing in the coming years.
Nava's funding is a testament to the increasing demand for AI solutions.
The company's focus on GPU cloud and data centre infrastructure is a key differentiator.

posts.caption: Nava, an enterprise AI startup, has raised $22M in funding to expand its GPU cloud and data centre infrastructure. This investment is a significant step forward for the company and the AI industry as a whole. It demonstrates the confidence of investors in the potential of AI to transform businesses.
